ideas.pitch: An AI-powered municipal expenditure forecaster and public procurement auditing tool for Canadian cities.
ideas.title: MapleGov Insight Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the rigorous predictive modeling and Poisson regression calibration seen in AI incident forecasting winners to appeal to civic tech judges looking for quantifiable public sector impact.

ideas.pitch: Satellite-based environmental compliance and industrial land monitoring platform tailored for Canadian natural resource regulations.
ideas.title: CanGeo Industrial Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven runner-up pattern of processing spatial and satellite data for industrial monitoring, directly targeting regulatory enforcement priorities.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered anti-money laundering risk intelligence platform combining graph analytics and explainable gradient boosting for Canadian fintech compliance.
ideas.title: NorthernShield FinCrime Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emulates a 1st place hackathon winner by focusing on complex enterprise financial data, explainable machine learning models, and real-time risk scoring.

ideas.pitch: Computer-vision-powered hockey shot and skating stride analyzer using pose estimation and confidence-gated classification.
ideas.title: PuckVision Biomechanics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies a proven 1st place sports-analytics computer vision architecture to a culturally relevant domain (hockey) to grab judge engagement during live demos.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition, intake, and trust verification platform for specialized Canadian healthcare clinics.
ideas.title: TrueNorth Patient Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the fast-paced integration of modern LLM APIs and healthcare workflows that won first prize in previous short-duration sprints.
